Messages.Author: Arnaud Clavel
Messages.Body:
Thank you LSJ for your answer about Ablative Skin. Here is another one :

if my acting minion S:CE, does the bloking minion has the possibility to
strike ? In the rules, it is written that S:CE ends immediatly the
combat. So ... i would say no.
If S:CE is played, the dammage done by DotB is not taken, is it ?

Thank you and have a Sweet Bleed.

K1

Messages.Author: Tim Eijpe
Messages.Body:
Hi Arnaud,

You are correct that you strike first as acting minion, but in VTES
strikes are considered to be simultaniously, so the blocking minion has
the option to strike. The srike will have no effect as you S:CE, unless
it is a Catatonic Fear. Then your acting minion will take one
unpreventable damage. [Provided the range is close]

Unfortunately (or not) the damage of DotB IS taken, as the round ends
after the S:CE. Also if you played a Dawn Operation, your acting minion
would take one unpreventable aggravated damage.

Hope this clears up the questions,

Tim Eijpe

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Tim Eijpe wrote:
> You are correct that you strike first as acting minion, but in VTES
> strikes are considered to be simultaniously, so the blocking minion has
> the option to strike. The srike will have no effect as you S:CE, unless
> it is a Catatonic Fear. Then your acting minion will take one
> unpreventable damage. [Provided the range is close]

To clarify - as the acting minion, you *choose* your strike before the
opposing minion chooses a strike. But both minions choose their respective
strikes before either strike resolves.

Strike resolution order is not determined by looking at who is the acting
minion. Strikes normally resolve simultaneously, although S:CE ends combat
immediately when it resolves (before any other strike resolution effects
take place), not when it is announced.

> Unfortunately (or not) the damage of DotB IS taken, as the round ends
> after the S:CE. Also if you played a Dawn Operation, your acting minion
> would take one unpreventable aggravated damage.

Correct. DotB damage is done at the end of the round, and the round ends
when S:CE resolves.
